events.observation:
Invented rules

The strider S takes one or two adjacent steps. Each enemy stone on its chosen route is captured. It can return to its origin. Stones do not move.

Choose i9, then j10, then i9 to capture and return. The alternative i9 → h9 → i9 ends on the same square and leaves the stone intact.

If a step can finish now or continue, choose Complete action here to stop at that step. Escape abandons the selection.

Native acceptance
